snapshot.business_summary: Persistent Systems is a global provider of digital engineering, technology, and consulting services. The company operates through three primary segments: Software, Hi-Tech and Emerging Industries; Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI); and Healthcare & Life Sciences. It focuses on product engineering, platform development, and end-to-end digital transformation for enterprises and technology companies.

trajectory.takeaway: The company has shown consistent sequential and year-on-year revenue growth, with Q2 FY27 revenue increasing by approximately 30% compared to Q2 FY26.
While annual PAT for FY26 was strong, Q2 FY27 saw a sequential and year-on-year decline, partly impacted by transaction-related costs and acquisition expenses.

bull.argument: Strategic long-term agreement with a US-based global technology leader expected to add $125M+ annually and $650M+ over 6.5 years.
Expansion of AI capabilities through preferred partnerships with Anthropic and Microsoft agentic business solution specializations.
Proposed acquisition of Nagarro SE to significantly enhance digital engineering scale and European market presence.

bear.argument: One-time acquisition-related expenses (estimated at $50M) and transaction costs weighing on reported EPS and PAT growth.
Slower conversion from AI pilots to enterprise-wide adoption in regulated sectors like BFSI and Healthcare compared to the tech sector.
Macroeconomic risks including potential inflation impacts from higher oil prices due to geopolitical tensions.
